column1: # Blind review of October's finished runs, 18 Nov 2026: sets test1-20261109-1244 (9 plans) and test2-20261118-1604 (5 builds), graded by Sol through Codex on Sherlock, in the November review's form (fit: usable as delivered; rank within a task or language; one-line note). Plans judged against their briefs (the owner's finished versions aren't on Sherlock) and October's specs. A plan run is fit only if every document is.

column8: note
plans/runs/15e450/01-playbook/proposal.md identifies the undefined playbook and proposes a measured discovery before selecting automation.
plans/runs/15e450/02-coauthor-language/proposal.md bounds a pilot and identifies Co-Author, output, jurisdiction and document type as unresolved prerequisites.
plans/runs/15e450/expense-tracker/specs/001-expense-tracker/spec.md FR-010 imports valid CSV rows despite errors; October requires rejecting the whole import.
plans/runs/15e450/habitkit/specs/001-habit-tracking-core/tasks.md T006 makes weekly quota determine scheduled days; October counts completed weeks for weekly streaks.
plans/runs/473e33/01-playbook/.specify/assessments/playbook/proposal.md lays out alternatives and asks for the playbook, users and baseline before committing.
plans/runs/473e33/02-coauthor-language/.specify/assessments/coauthor-language/proposal.md distinguishes extraction options and asks for product, formats, output and data boundaries.
plans/runs/473e33/expense-tracker/specs/001-expense-tracker/spec.md FR-016 imports readable CSV rows despite invalid rows, contrary to October’s all-or-nothing rule.
plans/runs/473e33/habitkit/specs/001-habit-tracker-core/spec.md US3 scenario 3 uses an elapsed-day denominator for weekly targets, instead of October’s weeks-starting-in-range formula.
plans/runs/5794aa/01-playbook/proposal.md asserts three-day-stale reports and budget overruns as observed TRG symptoms without support in the one-line brief.
plans/runs/5794aa/02-coauthor-language/proposal.md recommends a specific adapter and redaction before the target system and meaning of parsing are established.
plans/runs/5794aa/expense-tracker/specs/001-expense-tracker/spec.md FR-012 skips malformed CSV rows and data-model.md keys budgets by month, unlike the October reference.
plans/runs/5794aa/habitkit/specs/001-habit-tracking-core/spec.md gives 100% for a range before creation; October specifies 0 for an empty effective range.
plans/runs/57afdd/01-playbook/proposal.md prescribes a low-code onboarding workflow and claims existing inefficiencies without a documented playbook.
plans/runs/57afdd/02-coauthor-language/proposal.md promises high-precision Spanish legal extraction but leaves the parsing output and integration undefined.
plans/runs/57afdd/expense-tracker/specs/001-expense-tracker/spec.md edge cases skip invalid CSV rows, while October requires validating all rows and importing nothing on error.
plans/runs/57afdd/habitkit/specs/001-habitkit-core/research.md fixes Sunday-start weeks and tasks.md T021 leaves the incomplete-current-week streak rule unspecified.
plans/runs/63fb61/01-playbook/proposal.md commits to a SaaS workflow sprint while the actual playbook and its integrations are still unknown.

plans/runs/63fb61/02-coauthor-language/proposal.md recommends killing the extension because Co-Author is absent from the assessment repository, which does not establish that the product does not exist.
plans/runs/63fb61/expense-tracker/specs/001-expense-tracker/data-model.md appends valid CSV rows while skipping invalid rows; October requires no imports if any row is invalid.
plans/runs/63fb61/habitkit/specs/001-habit-tracking-core/spec.md US2 scenario 2 resets a daily streak when today is unchecked; October treats today as still open.
plans/runs/975d7d/01-playbook/.specify/assessments/playbook/proposal.md presents options and a hold pending the actual playbook, scope and baseline.
plans/runs/975d7d/02-coauthor-language/.specify/assessments/coauthor-language/proposal.md proposes demand and scope validation and identifies product, quality and data-handling questions.
plans/runs/975d7d/expense-tracker/specs/001-personal-expense-tracker/spec.md FR-009 imports valid rows and skips invalid ones, conflicting with October’s all-or-nothing import.
plans/runs/975d7d/habitkit/specs/001-habit-tracker-core/tasks.md T025 and T027 prorate partial weeks; October counts only weeks starting within the effective range.
plans/runs/a094e8/01-playbook/proposal.md asserts engineering overhead and prescribes a control plane without establishing the playbook or its users.
plans/runs/a094e8/02-coauthor-language/proposal.md promises absolute structural fidelity from a rules parser before the document types and output are known.
plans/runs/a094e8/expense-tracker/specs/001-expense-tracker/spec.md says malformed CSV rows are skipped and budgets reset or are redefined monthly, contrary to the October reference.

plans/runs/a094e8/habitkit/specs/001-habitkit-core/spec.md defines a broken scheduled day for flexible weekly quotas but does not specify the weekly streak or rate algorithm; no API contract is supplied.
plans/runs/b2c2e4/01-playbook/proposal.md makes documenting the current playbook and measuring its baseline the first phase before choosing automation.

plans/runs/b2c2e4/02-coauthor-language/.specify/assessments/coauthor-language/proposal.md identifies the missing Co-Author integration, input types and parsing output, then proposes a short validation step.
plans/runs/b2c2e4/expense-tracker/specs/001-expense-tracker/spec.md US4 scenario 2 imports valid rows despite invalid CSV rows; October requires importing nothing.
plans/runs/b2c2e4/habitkit/specs/001-habit-tracking/research.md section 5 counts every day in a weekly-target period as scheduled, rather than October’s weeks-starting-in-range calculation.
plans/runs/b8e189/01-playbook/proposal.md rejects the project based on an unestablished identification of TRG and an assumption that analog means IC design.
plans/runs/b8e189/02-coauthor-language/proposal.md narrows the request to BOE and assumes a Co-Author writing workflow without establishing either from the brief.

plans/runs/b8e189/expense-tracker/specs/001-expense-tracker/spec.md leaves key import and validation cases unresolved; tasks.md T030 only says to handle invalid rows, without October’s all-or-nothing rule.
plans/runs/b8e189/habitkit/specs/001-habit-tracking/spec.md US3 scenario 3 rejects check-ins after a weekly quota, while October records distinct check-ins and caps their contribution only in rates.
expenses/report.py budget_report iterates spending totals only, omitting budgeted categories with no spending; tests/test_budgets.py explicitly expects that omission.
Sources/HabitKit/HabitStore.swift computes weekdays from noon UTC in the supplied time zone, shifting the day in UTC+13/+14; the otherwise extensive streak tests use UTC.
Sources/HabitKit/HabitStore.swift implements schedule-aware streaks, bounded weekly rates and atomic persistence; Tests/HabitKitTests/HabitStoreTests.swift exercises boundaries and save/load.
Sources/HabitKit/HabitStore.swift weekly streak skips any number of incomplete weeks before finding an old complete week; its completion-rate loop also includes a week starting before the range.
Sources/HabitKit/HabitStore.swift silently treats every read or decoding failure as an empty store, risking loss on save; its persistence test covers a normal round trip.
